propositions: Bare substring containment in the upstream-URL assertion accepts lookalike hosts like pandoc.org.evil.com and notpandoc.org that do not actionably point to upstream

The assertion must be replaced with a scheme+host-anchored regex using negative lookahead (?![\w.-]) and (?![\w-]) to reject suffix and prefix style lookalikes while accepting legitimate NOTICE mentions
The regex must match https?://(www\.)?pandoc\.org(?![\w.-]) OR https?://github\.com/jgm/pandoc(?![\w-]) with explicit end-of-host boundaries
The change is isolated to the upstream-URL assertion and its module-level supporting regex, leaving version pins and NOTICE content unchanged
All existing tests in test_notice_records_pandoc_gpl.py must pass, lint and typecheck must pass, and code-scanning alert #88 must clear after the fix lands
